purpose: Curated web directories and visual sources for design research; no entitlement to third-party assets

sites.name: DevLibraries
sites.use: Compare concepts, frameworks, previews and per-library licenses. Drill down to ORIGINAL maintainer before selecting donor; never treat aggregate site as one OSS repo.
sites.source_content_summary: Indexed UI library/component directory; counts are dynamic and not a guaranteed inventory.
notes: No copying of code/assets from directory until original author/source license confirmed
React/Next.js examples are design references, not ready-to-use Flutter implementations

sites.name: Ruixen UI
sites.use: Reuse source-pinned research already tracked by Design-App; React code is not directly Flutter ready.
sites.source_content_summary: Existing source catalog 277 TSX references and 41 curated candidates, prior audit.

sites.name: Gentleface
sites.use: See existing 28 reference icons and app matrix; no vendored asset without license gate.
sites.source_content_summary: Previously documented Gentleface animated icon source.

sites.name: beUI
sites.use: Original source of Voice Orb surfaced by DevLibraries. Reference-only for Flutter and Compose.
sites.source_content_summary: Public original library with web and React Native implementations.

sites.name: easeUI
sites.use: Refer to source-pinned public MIT component for animation design, not as a replacement for Theme M3 or Flutter code.
sites.license: MIT source in rjcuff/easeui; easeUI Pro separate

sites.name: Amicro
sites.use: Confirm executable source files and dependencies for each specific item; four current names are metadata-only.
sites.license: MIT source root in Subhan-code/Amicro--Micro-transitions-; asset-specific gate

sites.name: Watermelon UI
sites.license: MIT original platform repository; asset/dependency rights separate; no Flutter runtime verified
sites.use: Use component repo source as concept and integrate only after Product Bible and framework/QA gate; three exact names are unlocated.

sites.name: Dribbble
sites.use: Inspect exact shot URL and author, extract general UI patterns; build original Flutter/Compose components. Never copy screenshot/artwork/code without separately documented permission.
sites.source_content_summary: Four individually inspected public shots linked in research audit, plus mobile design discovery.

sites.name: Collect UI
sites.use: Use curated category pages as inspiration, verify individual post and source before precise attribution or reuse. Several categories are empty/dynamic.
sites.source_content_summary: Verified sign-up, scroll-animation, infographic categories and trending; no assumed author-specific asset license.

sites.name: Uiverse
sites.source_content_summary: 108 authenticated personal favorites (11 added since 97, none removed), 111 total Uiverse components and 111 originals archived: 57 Galaxy archive snapshots + 54 live Uiverse HTML/CSS pairs; 736 PROPOSED_ONLY mappings across 25 apps
sites.license: MIT official source; external assets independently verified

sites.name: Flutter Gems
sites.use: On-demand discovery only; check original pub.dev GitHub license/SDK/updates; Design-App user-curated aesthetics first.

sites.name: Forui
sites.use: Single-widget pilot only after Product Bible and Design-App; verify Flutter SDK and footprint before adding package.

sites.name: F22 Labs Flutter UI comparison
sites.use: Second-hand overview; actual article dated Aug 4 2026, compare original package maintainers.

sites.name: Material Design 3 — Google
sites.use: Optional design system ONLY when selected for the individual app. Never mandatory and never banned. User-curated Design-App references and Product Bible precede. Preserve existing M3 if coherent; do not port Flutter Golden code into Kotlin/Compose.
sites.source_content_summary: Google Material 3 portal is JS-rendered for direct text; official Flutter & Android developer documentation confirms color, typography, shapes, components, dynamic color and Material 3 Expressive. Source is a design system, not an external OSS code donor.

sites.name: Motion Sites
recommended_for: Motion-first landing sections driven by content rather than decoration
sites.use: Prompt counts advertised by social post not independently verified; web-specific prompt results are not Flutter code.

sites.name: Motion Sites Studio
sites.use: Not admitted as equivalent to Lovable, code donor, or a free builder without direct live test.

sites.name: Land-book
recommended_for: Pricing-page hierarchy with distinct comparison tiers
sites.use: Individual captured websites remain third-party copyright; useful principally Web/PWA/Store landing.

sites.name: Recent Design
sites.use: Legacy godly.website points to this same service; indexed once only.

sites.name: Landdding
recommended_for: Sector-specific landing layouts for SaaS, utility and food
Filter content by industry and frontend platform
sites.use: Page is useful for marketing references; downloading a template is a distinct licensing check.

sites.name: Font in Logo
recommended_for: Match editorial title typography to product tone
Use commercially licensed alternatives, not copied brand logos
sites.use: Font lookalikes are not a license to copy a protected wordmark, title or trademark.

sites.name: 60FPS
recommended_for: Contextual bottom sheets, card transitions, long press
Swipe delete with explicit undo and stateful completion
Meaningful gallery transitions and reduced-motion variants
sites.use: Many filters (Calendar, Bottom Sheet, Delete, Empty State, Shared Element, Scrub); recordings do not supply Flutter code.

sites.name: Fontshare
recommended_for: Pair serif editorial headings with neutral readable UI fonts
Create character-set/language coverage checklist before choosing a family
sites.use: No font binary copied; only shortlist names with independently verified font family page and terms.

sites.name: Realtime Colors
recommended_for: Preview text/background/primary/secondary/accent combinations on real UI
Compare light/dark/contrast and export token candidates
sites.use: A website mockup is not proof that a Flutter component passes accessibility contrast or native rendering.

sites.name: Coolors
recommended_for: Generate candidate 5-color palettes, then test in actual screen
Use generated harmony only as a starting point for semantic tokens
sites.use: Do not assert unrestricted free exports/saves or full homepage access.

sites.name: Lucide
recommended_for: Consistent stroke and semantic icon naming
Map candidate glyphs to existing factory semantic icon adapter
sites.use: Already referenced in packs/icons/PROVENANCE.md; no duplicate runtime pack or Flutter donor admitted.

sites.name: SVGL
recommended_for: Find official provider logos for legitimate integration badges
Use metadata/API for discovery only; cache and permission review
sites.use: API says do not clone SVGL product; site notes logo permission. Never mass-bundle provider logos.

sites.name: Shots
recommended_for: Create marketing phone/device mockups from own QA screenshots
Create consistent portrait/landscape Play Store image compositions
sites.use: Promotional renders do not replace authentic in-app screenshots or runtime visual QA.

sites.name: Cosmos
recommended_for: Moodboard collections and search by color/similarity
Trace artist and source of visual reference
Explore collections/vision-board organization without copying thumbnails
sites.use: Do not upload/re-host copyrighted images from Cosmos as app assets without distinct permission.

sites.name: Best Designs on X
sites.use: Monitor design posts for product-specific patterns; link original author/post before attributing style or adding a specific asset.

sites.name: Figma Community — Mobile Apps
sites.use: Find exact Community design files, inspect reusable components and source licenses individually; this discovery portal is not one file or package.

sites.name: ReUI
sites.use: Free React/TypeScript/Tailwind components may be adapted into matching Web projects; for Flutter/Compose only pattern reference and native reimplementation. Pro blocks/icons separate.

sites.name: ThinkUI
recommended_for: MIT HTML/CSS component references with source per result
animated SVG icon discovery with per-item rights
sites.use: An agent may query the paid remote MCP for current UI references and verify provenance/license per item; do not connect or purchase without user approval. Screenshot reuse depends on source licence, never bulk archive.

sites.name: Mobbin
recommended_for: real shipped app onboarding and navigation flows
empty states and deletion confirmation UX benchmarking
sites.use: Use for narrow research of shipped mobile/web UX with source attribution; do not archive, mirror or republish third-party screenshots into Design-App or use ML to create derivatives without permission.

sites.name: React Bits
recommended_for: animated backgrounds for Web only when performant
sites.use: Use original repo as visual and engineering reference; in suitable React web product, source inclusion allowed under license, but do not redistribute components as standalone or ported library. For Flutter only build original native equivalents with QA, no direct TSX use.
